containers.title: Containers
containers.description: Containers across every reachable Linux/macOS host. Runtime (docker, podman, nerdctl) is detected per host; the list refreshes every 5 seconds.

noHosts.title: No reachable hosts

compose.title: Compose stacks
compose.description: Author and version docker-compose YAML, then apply it to any reachable Linux VM. Every save creates a new version.

stacks.title: Stacks
stacks.description: Select a stack to load it into the editor.

fields.name: Name

confirmDelete.title: Delete stack {name}?

history.title: Version history
history.description: Load an older version into the editor, then save to make it current.

terminal.title: Terminal
terminal.description: Open a shell on any reachable VM or inside a running container, over the SSH WebSocket bridge.

empty.title: No open sessions

noHosts.title: No reachable hosts
noHosts.description: A terminal needs a running Linux or macOS instance with a public address and a probe key on its account.

builds.title: Builds & registries
builds.description: Configure container registries, then build and push images locally on the Vatra host or remotely on any reachable VM.

registries.title: Registries
registries.description: Credentials are encrypted at rest and only used at push time.

registries.emptyHint: Add a registry before starting a build.

confirmDelete.title: Delete registry {name}?
confirmDelete.description: Builds that pushed to it keep their history; new builds can no longer target it.

runs.emptyHint: Start a build from an inline Dockerfile; output streams here.

gitops.title: GitOps
gitops.description: Watch a Git repository and auto-apply every compose change to a target VM. Supports public, HTTPS-token and SSH-key sources.

sources.title: Git sources
sources.description: Select a row to inspect its pipeline and sync log.

empty.title: No Git sources yet

confirmDelete.description: The source and its local clone cache are removed. Deployed stacks on the VM are left untouched.

pipeline.title: Pipeline · {name}
pipeline.description: Live status of the poll → fetch → match → apply chain, refreshed every 5 seconds.

log.title: Sync log

k8s.description: One-click k3s / k0s install, web-based kubectl and Helm deploys — all over SSH, no exposed API server.

noInstances.title: No reachable Linux VMs

kubectl.description: Runs kubectl on the server node over SSH.

helm.title: Helm install
helm.description: Adds the repository if given, then runs `helm upgrade --install`.

dr.title: DR drill
dr.description: Read-only verification that every running VM has a fresh backup, that provider credentials still work and that GitOps sources are syncing.

confirm.title: Run the DR drill?
confirm.description: The drill calls every provider's list API and reads local tables. It never creates, modifies or deletes infrastructure.

scope.title: 1 · What is checked
scope.description: Three families of checks run in sequence.

backups.title: Backups
backups.hint: Every running VM has a policy that succeeded in the last 7 days.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.hint: Each provider answers a list call with the stored keys.

gitops.title: GitOps
gitops.hint: Enabled sources synced recently without errors.

run.title: 2 · Run
run.description: Results appear here as soon as the drill completes.
run.hint: Use the button in the header to start. Nothing on your infrastructure is touched.

restore.title: Restore
restore.description: Launch a new VM from a successful backup. Cross-cloud: pick any account and region — Vatra hands the snapshot to the provider and calls createInstance.

launch.launchedHint: The provider is booting the new VM. It appears in the instances list after the next sync.

backups.title: Backups & disaster recovery
backups.description: Snapshots across every cloud account plus local AES-256-GCM archives. Replicate, restore, verify.

reboot-all-running.description: Soft-reboot every running VM. Useful after kernel updates.

autoPark.title: Idle VM auto-park
autoPark.description: Stop VMs that show no activity for a while. Opt-in per VM; a parked VM is left alone for 24 h.

fields.netKbpsHint: 1–10 000. Below this the VM counts as idle.

autoPark.confirmDisableHint: The VM will keep running when idle until you enable it again.

configBackup.title: Config backup & restore
configBackup.description: Export every config table (accounts, keys, schedules, webhooks, recipes…) as JSON and restore it on a fresh host. Encrypted credentials need the same VMUI_MASTER_KEY.
configBackup.repickFile: Pick the file again to confirm
configBackup.confirmTitle: Truncate every config table and restore from this file?
configBackup.confirmDescription: All current accounts, keys, schedules, webhooks and recipes are replaced. This cannot be undone.

export.title: Export a snapshot
export.description: Download the current configuration before changing anything.
export.excluded: Operational tables (audit log, sync history, instances, pricing) are excluded.

pick.title: Pick a snapshot file
pick.description: Choose a JSON snapshot produced by the export above. A dry-run starts automatically.
pick.fileHint: JSON only. Nothing is written until you confirm in step 4.

dryRun.title: Dry-run
dryRun.description: Validates the file and reports how many rows each table would receive.
dryRun.summaryTitle: {total, plural, =1 {# row} other {# rows}} would be restored
dryRun.summaryHint: Review the per-table counts above before confirming.

restore.title: Confirm restore
restore.description: Applies the snapshot. Available only after a successful dry-run.
restore.warningTitle: Restore truncates every config table first
restore.warningHint: Use only on a fresh or empty install. Existing rows are replaced, not merged.
restore.doneHint: {total, plural, =1 {# row} other {# rows}} written. Reload the app to pick up the new accounts.

bootScriptDiff.title: Boot-script diff
bootScriptDiff.description: Line diff between two boot scripts. Useful before re-applying one.
bootScriptDiff.pickDescription: A is the base, B is the target. Added lines come from B.
bootScriptDiff.emptyHint: Pick two scripts above and press Compare.

webhooks.title: Instance webhooks
webhooks.description: POST JSON to a URL on instance state transitions. When a secret is set an x-vmui-signature: sha256=… HMAC header is added.
webhooks.listDescription: Each hook fires for every matching instance state change and is retried with backoff.
webhooks.formDescription: Leave scope fields empty to receive events from every account and instance.

fields.urlHint: Must be reachable from this host. HTTPS recommended.
fields.secretHint: Optional. Used to sign the body; stored as-is.
fields.instanceHint: Optional. Restrict to a single instance (e.g. i-…, zone/name).

webhooks.testAria: Send a test event to this webhook
webhooks.emptyHint: Add a URL to be notified when an instance changes state.

deliveries.title: Webhook deliveries
deliveries.description: Outbound webhooks with exponential backoff. Max 5 attempts; backoff 30 s × 2ⁿ up to 1 h.
deliveries.notRetryable: Only failed deliveries can be retried
deliveries.emptyHint: Deliveries appear here once a webhook fires.
